premise: Every surprise makes shy Hedgehog curl into a prickly ball — Mushroom's sneeze, Woodpecker's TAP TAP — so he keeps missing the fun; then his friends say hello softly, and out he peeks.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop): what noise and bluster can't do, gentleness does; turned into two friends learning to whisper.
lesson: Gentleness makes room for shy friends.
learning: A hedgehog rolls into a prickly ball when something startles it.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Curls Up
en-US.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog wanted to play. But Hedgehog was shy. {hedgehog:face happy} Hello, he said, very quietly. Up popped {mushroom:enter} Mushroom. {mushroom:face happy} Hello, Hedgehog! Then her nose began to twitch. {mushroom:live} Ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] Oh! {hedgehog:live hold} In a flash, Hedgehog rolled up into a round, prickly ball. Prickly ball! {mushroom:face sad} Oops, said Mushroom. Sorry. Slowly… slowly… {hedgehog:live resume} Hedgehog uncurled and peeked out. Then {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Woodpecker landed on the trunk of the big tree. [excited] Good morning, everybody! {woodpecker:live} {sfx:tap} TAP-TAP-TAP! {hedgehog:live hold} Prickly ball again! {woodpecker:face sad} Oh dear, said Woodpecker. {mushroom:sparkle} Mushroom had an idea. [whispers] Let's say it softly. So, very gently, they whispered: {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} Hello, Hedgehog. [pause] {hedgehog:live resume} Out came his nose. Out came his eyes. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} Hello, he whispered back. And they played the quietest game in the whole meadow.

es-ES.title: Erizo se hace una bola
es-ES.text: [softly] {hedgehog:enter} Erizo quería jugar. Pero Erizo era tímido. {hedgehog:face happy} Hola, dijo, muy bajito. Asomó {mushroom:enter} Seta. {mushroom:face happy} ¡Hola, Erizo! Entonces empezó a picarle la nariz. {mushroom:live} Aaa… aaa… {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! {hedgehog:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Oh! {hedgehog:live hold} En un periquete, Erizo se hizo una bola redonda de pinchos. ¡Bola de pinchos! {mushroom:face sad} Uy, dijo Seta. Perdona. Despacito… despacito… {hedgehog:live resume} Erizo se desenrolló y asomó la nariz. Entonces {woodpecker:enter} {woodpecker:go to trunks} Pájaro carpintero se posó en el tronco del árbol grande. [excited] ¡Buenos días a todos! {woodpecker:live} {sfx:tap} ¡TOC-TOC-TOC! {hedgehog:live hold} ¡Bola de pinchos otra vez! {woodpecker:face sad} Vaya, dijo Carpintero. {mushroom:sparkle} Seta tuvo una idea. [whispers] Vamos a decirlo flojito. Y los dos susurraron: {mushroom:face happy} {woodpecker:face happy} Hola, Erizo. [pause] {hedgehog:live resume} Asomó la nariz. Asomaron los ojos. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} Hola, susurró él. Y jugaron al juego más calladito de todo el prado.

achoo.prompt: a tiny, cute comic sneeze, achoo, with a soft sparkly twinkle after it, playful

tap.prompt: a woodpecker tapping quickly on tree bark, tap-tap-tap, realistic field recording
